lines:
sequenceDiagram
 participant Loop as Frozen Agent loop
 participant Broker as Trusted tool broker
 participant Store as Canonical Chat evidence
 participant Compress as Local compression pipeline
 participant Model as Provider
 Loop->>Store: Commit outer invocation node and child scope
 Model-->>Loop: Tool call proposal
 Loop->>Broker: Validate frozen binding and invoke
 Broker->>Store: Settle original result
 Loop->>Compress: Fresh result and frozen policy
 Compress->>Compress: Lossless formats with reconstruction and savings gate
 opt Adaptive mode and selected retrieval tool
  Compress->>Compress: Protected spans plus relevance diversity and anomalies
 end
 Compress->>Store: Commit scoped original reference and stable projection
 Store-->>Loop: Durable projection
 Loop->>Model: Admit result then balanced compaction at pressure
 Note over Loop,Model: Previous projections remain unchanged across retries and requests
 Model-->>Broker: Context read search or stats proposal
 Broker->>Store: Resolve only within committed invocation scope
 Store-->>Model: Bounded original page or ranked exact spans
 Note over Store,Model: Retrieval bypasses compression
 opt Explicit Chat fork
  Store->>Store: Copy scoped archive with parent provenance
 end

data.title: Fresh observation compression and durable retrieval
